text:
Maya: Heads up — sampleapp on staging starts spiking 429s during onboarding stress tests, looks like prefetch + pagination burst.
Ali: ugh. any logs?
Maya: logs show lots of concurrent cursor fetches and repeated token refresh calls. chunk of requests: `POST /v1/embeddings?cursor=...` and then auth retry loop.
Jamie: is it the client prefetch window being too large? we prefetch 3 pages by default.
Maya: looks like it. Also token refresh race — multiple inflight requests trigger refresh at same time producing duplicate work + extra 401->retry storms.
Sam: quick snippet from sampleapp config:
```
prefetch: 3
concurrency: 16
retry: { maxAttempts: 4, backoff: 200 }
```
Maya: we call next-page immediately on prefetch, even if earlier page still queued to server -> server-side queueing + our client retries + batching misalignment = pressure.
Ali: can reproduce locally with small script. will try reducing prefetch and adding token refresh lock.
Sam: FYI SDKs have different default behaviors: js-sdk currently does prefetch 3, go-sdk 1. parity issue.
Jamie: big point — SDK parity here matters for onboarding experience. if different SDKs prefetch differently customers see inconsistent throttling.
Maya: proposed quick fixes: set prefetch to 1 for sampleapp onboarding template, add a singleflight/token-refresh lock in client, and add request dedupe for pagination cursors.
Ali: +1. also tune concurrency down to 6 for the default template.
Sam: token-lock pattern (pseudocode):
```
if (isRefreshing) { await refreshPromise; } else { refreshPromise = doRefresh(); await refreshPromise; }
```
Jamie: what about backoff? our retry jitter is tiny, we should use exponential backoff with jitter on 429s not linear.
Maya: agree. change retry to exponential base 200ms, cap 5s, random jitter.
ci-bot: deploy scheduled: update-sampleapp-config -> staging @ 1719460500
Ali: I'll open a small PR to the sampleapp repo with default prefetch=1, concurrency=6, and the token-lock util.
Sam: I'll add tests for token refresh dedupe in js-sdk and note parity change in changelog.
Jamie: add a note to onboarding docs: "If you see 429s during signup, reduce prefetch or increase concurrency cap" — but wording maybe more prescriptive: default template already lowered.
Maya: one more: add a debug flag to sampleapp to dump token refresh events and cursor dedupe metrics so we can confirm fix.
Ali: good call. I'll attach a tiny histogram export to logs.
Maya: timeline? if PRs merged today we can deploy to staging this afternoon and re-run stress tests.
Sam: should we also include a short snippet in SDK README showing how to set prefetch and concurrency? simple example helps.
Jamie: yep, sample code and a one-line note about token refresh locking.
Maya: thanks folks. followups: Ali PR, Sam tests, Jamie docs. I'll run the stress tests after staging deploy and report results here. :thumbsup:
Ali: on it.
ci-bot: PR Ali/sampleapp#42 opened by Ali at 1719459000
Maya: closing loop — after changes deployed, 429s dropped ~90% in our run. will post graphs next.
